limitations: Arithmetic reanalysis of raw records only; it does not independently establish source/build, cache-hit, launch identity or numerical correctness.
Whole worker trials are independent units. Replay blocks and within-worker order strata are repeated observations.
Capture order and launch position both follow trial parity; parity summaries cannot distinguish their individual effects.
Order-stratum differences are descriptive. Their absence does not exclude process or device history effects.
Profiling costs under different measurement objectives are different quantities. Profiler margins describe each race, not serving speedup.
This is one fixed layer on one H100, with no persistence, full-model accuracy or serving-throughput qualification.
